why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the FareUp app Start on the FareUp app . The homepage says it is free to play and that browsing needs no signup.
2 Step 2 : Pick a flight route Browse the real routes on offer and check each one's current price and trend before choosing.
3 Step 3 : Predict up or down Choose Next Day or Next Week, then tap up or down to say where you think the fare will go.
4 Step 4 : Earn points and climb the leaderboard Correct predictions earn points and streaks build on them. Keep predicting to move up the leaderboard.
